name: word-travels-in-order
checks: C370 v3.4 'Word Travels' in story order on one save at story level: one Lv18 Lotad_H (RAIN_DISH; THUNDER_SHOCK, ABSORB, GROWL, CHARGE, all its level-up moves by 18). (1) The Route 104 schoolkid turns. (2) On Route 109 the LOTAD DOLL is in view from the Briney landing before any text, and the kids face the sea; TOBY's SHOCK WAVE is 'not very effective' and Lotad wins with ABSORB ('Heard it from a kid on 104.'). (3) Heal at the Mauville Pokémon Center. (4) DAX at the gym door, 0 boxes before the battle: THUNDERSHOCK 'doesn't affect' SANDSHREW 19, ABSORB is 'super effective'. The ink arrives ahead of the player twice, less complete each time. Screenshots wt-1/2/3 are the arc's contact sheet. C372: the whole TOBY fight is ≤6 ABSORB turns (maxTurns 1 + 5).
